subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw add a second native completion-routing contract beyond `sessions_yield`, and if so should it be per-spawn only or also configurable globally and per agent with fail-closed parent delivery?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but code review cannot choose the permanent tool API, configuration footprint, persisted policy, and user-visible fallback semantics without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep the documented `sessions_yield` path and reopen or replace this PR only when a feature owner sponsors a narrower routing contract.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn routing
options.body: Approve only an explicit per-call override and remove global and per-agent defaults until persistent policy demand is established.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Accept the tool parameter, two config paths, persisted target, channel default, and no-channel-fallback parent behavior as permanent API.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the documented `sessions_yield` path and reopen or replace this PR only when a feature owner sponsors a narrower routing contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work covers the affected spawn, yield, handoff, and completion lifecycle surfaces.
